version: sensitivity addendum to endpoint-aware follow-up v3
registered_after: Primary endpoint-aware and vibration-only results, two internal reviews of the manuscript (2026-09-30) and the author's instruction to resolve all review items; recorded before any run listed below
primary_unchanged: Primary folds, seed 20260929, models, targets A1-A3 and R, and all primary numbers stay as reported. Every analysis below is secondary and is reported whatever it shows. No result below replaces a primary value or selects a new primary seed, allocation or case set.

seed_sensitivity.report: For each of the three seeds, all eight learned predictors fitted with that seed; first-rank fractions per criterion with the primary 10,000 bearing draws; the largest fraction and its model per criterion.

allocations.swap: validation = bearing two places after the test bearing, calibration = the next bearing; the fitting bearings are those of the primary design
allocations.reverse: validation = previous bearing, calibration = the bearing before it, in sorted circular order; the fitting bearings change

role_allocation_sensitivity.models: all eight learned predictors and six reference controls
role_allocation_sensitivity.report: Mean normalized error, bearings at or below 0.20, late-life error, per-bearing coverage and interval half-width, first-rank fractions, and the one-hour first-trigger rule against always acting, for every method reported in the maintenance analysis.

saved_result_diagnostics: First-rank fractions among the seven families common to both input sets, for both input sets
Support of every nonzero prognostic horizon (records, residual time)
Paired late-life error differences between the latent-state network and each reference control; paired latent-state minus attention normalized error
Conditional mean and median residual life of the fitting lifetimes as a population control
Error over the last 40% of each observed life (exploratory, not prespecified before the primary results)
Calendar gaps longer than 5 min per test
One-hour first-trigger timing: acquisitions at which the lower bound triggers at the first record
bootstrap: 10,000 whole-bearing draws with the primary generator seed 20260929 and fractional tie credit, as in summarize.py
